conflicts.rationale: findPatient's return widens from Patient to Patient | null (no more fallback to the first patient). visits.ts passes the value through unchanged (visitPatient has an inferred return type) and still compiles; the concurrently created visit page, two hops away, reads patient.name without a null check (TS18047). R1 (signature change) and R4 (error at the use site) also describe it.
